name: Fox and the Mud Axe
shortDescription: Fox frightens Tok with an impressive-looking axe, until clever Sparrow discovers that the terrifying blade is only made of mud.
longDescription: Fox uses a fake mud axe to frighten Tok into giving up her eggs. When Sparrow notices cracks, clay marks and Fox avoiding water, she helps Tok uncover the trick. A single drop of water exposes the false axe, and Fox must return what he took and help strengthen Tok's nest.
